channel.title: Georgia Public Broadcasting - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Georgia Public Broadcasting (gpb.org)

item.title: Lawmakers push a new mental health hospital as a solution to statewide crisis
item.description: The $409 million dollar proposal is being touted as the first of its kind in decades.

item.title: 7 key things to know about Trump's tariffs after the Supreme Court decision
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled Friday that President Trump overstepped his authority in ordering tariffs on nearly everything the U.S. imports. Here's some economic context to understand that decision.

item.title: Georgia Today: Atlanta United 2026 season; Funding for mental health hospital; Trump visit
item.description: On the Feb 20th edition: Atlanta United kicks off the 2026 season tomorrow; Georgia lawmakers are seeking funding to build a new mental health hospital; President Trump visited Northwest Georgia yesterday. His speech touched on tariffs, the upcoming Congressional race, and the 2020 election.

item.title: In Berlin, there are movies, there's politics and there's talk about it all
item.description: Buzz around whether the city's film festival would take a stance on the war in Gaza has dominated conversation in recent days.

item.title: What worked and what didn't with a cellphone ban at a Kentucky school
item.description: Keeping students off their devices is the new norm in many schools. We talked to students and educators at one Kentucky school to see how it's working.

item.title: Trump calls SCOTUS tariffs decision 'deeply disappointing' and lays out path forward
item.description: President Trump claimed the justices opposing his position were acting because of partisanship, though three of those ruling against his tariffs were appointed by Republican presidents.

item.title: Alex Ferreira wins 10th gold medal for Team USA, matching America's highest total in Winter Olympics
item.description: Freeskier Alex Ferreira clinches a tenth gold medal for the U.S. in these Games, tying the U.S.'s all-time record for gold medals in a Winter Olympics.

item.title: Using saliva to detect disease holds promise, but it's not perfected yet
item.description: Easier than a blood test, saliva tests have the potential to detect cavities, infections and even cancer. But a lack of insurance coverage and other obstacles stand in the way of wider use.

item.title: After dominant 6-2 win, the U.S. will face Canada for Olympic men's hockey gold
item.description: In the semifinal, Slovakia had few answers for the American onslaught. Now, the U.S. men will meet Canada for a chance to win the team's first Olympic hockey gold since the "Miracle on Ice" back in 1980.

item.title: After the Supreme Court's ruling on tariffs, companies line up for refunds
item.description: The Supreme Court on Friday struck down President Trump's tariffs. But the justices left a $133 billion question unanswered: What's going to happen to the money the government has already collected?
